children: As Samvat 2083 set to begin, brokerages Motilal Oswal Financial Services and Ventura Securities have identified stocks across banking, healthcare, capital markets, manufacturing, consumption, technology and electric mobility that they believe could offer investment opportunities in the upcoming year.

Motilal Oswal has picked 10 stocks for Samvat 2083, including Titan, Kotak Mahindra Bank, Adani Ports, Eternal, BSE, Shaily Engineering and Unimech Aerospace and set their target prices, indicating potential upside of up to 41 percent.
Similarly, Ventura Securities has also selected six stocks, including HDFC Bank, Park Medi World, Paytm, Meesho, LG Electronics India and Ather Energy, with potential upside of up to 83.7 percent.

The Diwali 2026 stock recommendations come against the backdrop of a challenging year for Indian equities. Motilal Oswal noted that Samvat 2083 comes at a time when India is standing at a point where a resilient domestic economy is facing a challenging external backdrop. It said that Nifty50 declined around 12 percent during Samvat 2082 up to October 29, 2026, amid the West Asia conflict, elevated crude oil prices, rupee weakness and foreign investor outflows.

However, the brokerage believes that the domestic growth remains robust, with GDP at 7.8 percent in Q1 FY27, while budgeted capex of Rs 12.2 lakh crore and last year’s tax and GST relief support demand, and record SIP inflows have absorbed foreign selling. Action also remains in the primary market: Jio Platforms’ record IPO and NSE’s listing headlined a busy year, with over 225 companies in the pipeline.

“We perceive FY27 to mark a return to double-digit earnings growth, with Nifty EPS expected to grow 16%/14% YoY in FY27/FY28 vs 5% in FY26. Nifty valuations are attractive at 17.5x forward earnings, 16% below the long-term average,” Motilal Oswal noted.
Key events in Samvat 2083
Energy shock & policy response (West Asia conflict, Brent above $100/bbl, RBI repo rate hike cycle)
Earnings growth trajectory (Nifty50 EPS growth 16% for FY27E and 14% for FY28E )
Foreign selling vs domestic flows (FII outflows of ~$28b in Jan-Sep’26, offset by record SIP inflows
Outlook

The brokerage said Samvat 2083 begins on a cautious note, as an external energy shock overshadows a resilient economy. The West Asia conflict has kept Brent crude above $100/bbl, lifting CPI inflation to 5.54 percent in September and prompting a 25 bps repo rate hike to 5.50%, it said.
“Record FII outflows of about USD28b in Jan–Sep’26 and a rupee near Rs 95/USD have weighed on large caps, with the Nifty down about 12% over Samvat 2082,” the brokerage added.
Diwali stock picks 2026 by Motilal Oswal
1.Kotak Mahindra Bank: Target Price Rs 500, 8% upside

Motilal Oswal has picked Kotak Mahindra Bank, with a target price of Rs 500, implying an upside of 8 percent. The brokerage expects healthy growth across retail, small business and corporate lending, with loan growth guided at around 1.5-2 times nominal GDP growth.

“Margins should recover as surplus foreign currency deposits are deployed and higher repo rates pass through to loan yields. Unsecured loan quality is improving,” it said, adding that it estimates net interest income and net profit CAGRs of around 19.7% and 24.1% over FY26 and FY28, with return on assets of 2.07% in FY27.
2. Adani Ports: Target Price Rs 2,130, 15% upside

Motilal Oswal has set a target price of Rs 2,130 for Adani Ports, indicating an upside of 15 percent. Motilal Oswal expects port capacity additions, infrastructure projects and global acquisitions to provide growth visibility, with cargo volumes are projected to grow at a CAGR of 14 per cent over FY26-FY28.
3. Titan: Target Price Rs 6,000, 35% upside

The brokerage set a target price of Rs 6,000 for Titan, offering an indicated upside of 35 percent. It said the company’s strong jewellery brand, store expansion and increasing share of studded jewellery are expected to support growth. The brokerage estimates revenue, operating profit and net profit CAGRs of 17 per cent, 21 per cent and 23 per cent, respectively, over FY26-FY29.
4. Eternal: Target Price Rs 420, 22% upside

Eternal, with a target price of Rs 420 and an upside of 22 per cent, is another pick by Motilal Oswal. The brokerage stated Eternal benefits from its leading food delivery platform and Blinkit’s quick commerce network, with food delivery order value targeted to grow over 20 percent in long term. Motilal Oswal highlighted Blinkit's plan to expand its store network to more than 3,500 by the end of FY27 and around 5,000 by the end of FY28.
5. BSE: Target Price Rs 4,000, 14% upside

Motilal Oswal has set a target price of Rs 4,000, with 14 percent upside potential on BSE. The brokerage said BSE’s futures and options turnover is up 85 percent in October 2026 so far, and the partial rollback of closing auction session norms from December 7, 2026 adds support.
6. SPR Auto Components: Target Price 6,150, 41% upside

SPR Auto Components is Motilal Oswal's top pick in terms of indicated upside, at 41 percent, with a target price of Rs 6,150. The brokerage expects the company to benefit from its evolution from a piston manufacturer into a diversified auto-component platform, with over 45% market share in pistons. Acquisitions, higher content per vehicle and multi-fuel adoption are expected to support earnings growth.
7. Shaily Engineering: Target Price Rs 4,074, 29% upside

Shaily Engineering has a target price of Rs 4,074, indicating an upside of 29 percent. Rising demand for healthcare products, particularly GLP-1 pens, capacity additions and opportunities in consumer electronics and semiconductors are key growth drivers. The brokerage expects operating margins to exceed 32 per cent by FY28.
8. Arvind: Target Price 670, 37% upside

Arvind has a target price of Rs 670, implying an upside of 37 percent. Arvin’s evolution towards garments and advanced materials-led business, supported by new capacities and a strong order book, is expected to drive growth. The potential India-UK free trade agreement could add a lever.
9. Unimech Aerospace: Target Price Rs 2,138, 35% upside

Unimech Aerospace, with a target price of Rs 2,138 and an upside of 35 percent, is another pick of Motilal Oswal for Diwali 2026. The brokerage said the company is positioned to benefit from rising aerospace outsourcing, backed by long-term global contracts, a strong order pipeline, opportunities in nuclear, semiconductors and oil and gas are expected to support growth.
10. Symbiotec Pharmalab: Target Price Rs 1,430, 15% upside

Symbiotec Pharmalab, with a target price of Rs 1,430 and an upside of 15 percent, is expanding from steroid-based pharmaceutical ingredients (38 percent global volume shares) into contract drug development and complex injectables. Its export exposure and investments in new manufacturing capacity are expected to support growth as these facilities are commercialised.
Diwali Stock Picks 2026 by Ventura Securities

Ventura Securities has recommended six stocks across banking, healthcare, fintech, e-commerce, consumer durables and electric mobility, with Park Medi World offering the highest indicated upside of 83.7 percent. The selection highlights companies with promising growth opportunities and company-specific business triggers, said the brokerage.
1.Park Medi World: 83.7% upside

Park Medi World offers the highest upside among the Diwali picks, supported by its aggressive hospital expansion across North India. The brokerage said the company has a 2,680-bed project pipeline across acquisitions, greenfield, brownfield, O&M and PPP projects. Rising ARPOB, a higher super-speciality mix and operating leverage from maturing hospitals should support strong earnings growth. Revenue, EBITDA and PAT are expected to grow at CAGRs of 26.8%, 28.8% and 33.7%, respectively, over FY26-FY29E, it added.
2. HDFC Bank: Potential upside of 68.6%

Ventura's investment case rests on the lender's strong asset quality, robust capitalisation and improving balance-sheet positioning. Deposits are growing faster than loans, while operating efficiency remains strong. The key trigger is a recovery in net interest margins as the deposit mix gradually shifts toward lower-cost funding. With credit costs remaining contained and loan growth broad-based, earnings growth should improve as margins normalise.
3. One97 Communications Ltd (Paytm): Potential upside of 30.4%

Ventura believes Paytm is transitioning from a revenue-growth story to sustained profit compounding. Higher merchant monetisation, improving payment margins, financial-services distribution and operating leverage are expected to drive growth. Merchant subscriptions, advertising, lending distribution and international expansion are additional growth drivers. The brokerage expects revenue, EBITDA and net profit to grow at CAGRs of 27.6 percent, 86.1 percent and 68.6 percent, respectively, through FY29.
4. Meesho: Potential upside of 27.4%

The brokerage believes Meesho is positioned to benefit from the structural expansion of value e-commerce across Tier-II, Tier-III and rural India. Its zero-commission, asset-light marketplace model supports rapid scaling at relatively low capital intensity. “Higher order density, AI-led personalisation, Valmo logistics optimisation and monetisation through advertising, seller services and financial services should improve profitability, with EBITDA and PAT expected to turn positive by FY28E,” it added.
5. LG Electronics India: Potential upside of 27.3%

Premiumisation, localisation, exports and capacity expansion are expected to support the company's growth. Its Rs 5,000 crore investment in Sri City, higher compressor and room air-conditioner (RAC) capacity, expansion in the B2B segment and rising revenue from annual maintenance contracts (AMCs) are key triggers. Ventura estimates revenue, EBITDA and PAT CAGRs of 13.3 percent, 22.8 percent and 21.5 cent, respectively, over FY26-FY29.
6. Ather Energy: Potential upside of 11.2% (HOLD)

Ventura sees long-term growth opportunities in India's electric two-wheeler market, supported by rising EV penetration, expansion into the mass-market scooter segment and manufacturing capacity additions. Its technology-led platform, improving localisation and higher volumes should drive better unit economics and operating leverage. However, with the target implying only 11.2 percent upside from the current price, the stock carries a ‘HOLD’ rating despite the strong long-term growth opportunity, the brokerage stated.

title: Diwali stock picks 2026: Motilal Oswal, Ventura bet on 16 stocks with up to 84% upside for Samvat 20283; HDFC Bank, Titan, Paytm and more
